description: R4 'excluded from ranking (shown but unranked)' (behavioral-spec.md:39-40) never defines where an unranked element sits in the single leaderboard array that R6 renders 'in order' (behavioral-spec.md:46) -> nondeterministic render. It also never states whether an unverified row's schema-required net_worth_usd is included in total_net_worth_usd (telemetry-aggregate.js:2). If included, the headline total contains unverified money; if nulled to exclude, the reducer NaNs (round-1 FIND-013 reintroduced).

evidence.snippet: the row SHALL be marked net_worth_src:"unverified" and excluded from ranking (shown but unranked)
